changed.title: Finite-length one-way memory for counting cyclic words with positive rank-one boundary counts
changed.statement:
∀ (w t m : Nat), 0 < w →
  let D := 2^w
  let Rows := Nat → Nat → Bool
  let mass := fun (rows : Rows) (h seed tail : Nat) =>
    ((List.range (2^(w+h))).filter (fun bits =>
      bits % D == seed && (bits >>> h) % D == tail &&
      (List.range h).all (fun i => rows i ((bits >>> i) % (2*D))))).length
  let L := w+t
  let n := L+w
  let good := fun (tables : Rows) =>
    ∃ a b : Fin D → Nat, (∀ i, 0 < a i) ∧ (∀ j, 0 < b j) ∧
      ∀ s z : Fin D, mass tables L s.val z.val = a s * b z
  let count := fun (left right : Rows) =>
    ((List.range (2^n)).filter (fun word => (List.range n).all (fun site =>
      let pat := (List.range (w+1)).foldl (fun (acc bit : Nat) =>
        acc ||| ((word.testBit ((site+bit)%n)).toNat <<< bit)) 0
      if site < L then left site pat else right (site-L) pat))).length % m
  let C := if m = 0 then 2^t else min (2^t) m
  let lower := 2^((D/2)*Nat.log2 C)
  let upper := C^(2*D)
  upper ≤ lower^8 ∧
  (∃ (encode : Rows → Fin upper) (read : Fin upper → Rows → Nat),
    ∀ p q : Rows, good p → read (encode p) q = count p q) ∧
  (∀ (S : Nat) (send : Rows → Fin S) (answer : Fin S → Rows → Nat),
    (∀ left right : Rows, good left → answer (send left) right = count left right) →
    lower ≤ S) ∧
  ∀ (S R : Nat), 0 < R →
    ∀ (put : Fin R → Rows → Fin S) (get : Fin R → Fin S → Rows → Nat),
      (∀ x y : Rows, good x →
        2*R ≤ 3*((List.finRange R).filter (fun coin =>
          get coin (put coin x) y == count x y)).length) →
      lower ≤ 2*S^11
changed.unlocks: bounds the messages needed for exact and modular counts when parties use deterministic protocols or share random bits under the positive factorization promise
changed.context: Fixing endpoints leaves t free bits. Send both positive factors exactly or modulo m. After w free rows insert copies before r=floor(log2 C) oriented layers. Subtraction distinguishes the endpoint vectors in [1,2^r], also modulo m. Pin seed zero. A random terminal subset distinguishes two vectors with probability at least 1/2. Repeat 11 times for plurality error below 1/8. Fix the random bits by averaging. Over half the vectors have error below 1/4 and need distinct message tuples. For C>1, log2 C < r+1 and r+1<=2r. Gate-price companions cannot exist for a message bound.

changed.title: The solution-count matrix for two families of local Boolean tests has rank two to the number of shared variables
changed.statement:
∀ (K : Type) [Field K] (n l r : ℕ)
  (L : Fin l → Finset (Fin n)) (R : Fin r → Finset (Fin n)),
  (∀ v : Fin n, (∃ i, v ∈ L i) ∨ ∃ j, v ∈ R j) →
  let S := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter
    (fun v => (∃ i, v ∈ L i) ∧ ∃ j, v ∈ R j)
  let Left := (i : Fin l) → ((↥(L i) → Bool) → Bool)
  let Right := (j : Fin r) → ((↥(R j) → Bool) → Bool)
  let count := fun (p : Left) (q : Right) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
      (∀ i, p i (fun v => x v.val) = true) ∧
      (∀ j, q j (fun v => x v.val) = true))).card
  ∀ d : ℕ,
    (∃ (A : Left → Fin d → K) (B : Right → Fin d → K),
      ∀ p q, (count p q : K) = ∑ j : Fin d, A p j * B q j) ↔
    2 ^ S.card ≤ d
changed.unlocks: determines the rank of a local table solution-count matrix over every field from its shared variable count
changed.context: Group solutions by their shared assignment. For each assignment, count extensions on each side using only sites on that side, then multiply. Pad these coordinates by zeros. Conversely, for each shared string pin every private bit to zero and let each local table accept exactly the restriction of this assignment. Matching pins have one solution and mismatched pins have none. The resulting identity matrix factors through the same d coordinates, forcing 2^s ≤ d over every field. Gate-price companions cannot exist for a matrix rank.
